votes.motion: Approve the work session and formal meeting minutes of October 1, 2024.
votes.description: Routine approval of the work session and formal meeting minutes from the October 1, 2024 City Council meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Public Utilities Revenue Bonds, Series 2025.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing for a parameters resolution authorizing issuance of up to $225,000,000 in Public Utilities revenue bonds to finance water and sewer capital improvements including the City Creek Water Treatment Plant and a new water reclamation facility.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the S-Line Conveyance of Significant Parcels.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing regarding the transfer of significant City-owned parcels along the S-Line corridor to the RDA to facilitate an extension of the S-Line Streetcar to Highland Drive and adjacent transit-oriented development.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on Budget Amendment No. 2 for Fiscal Year 2024-25 and refer the item to a future date for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the FY2024-25 Budget Amendment No. 2, which includes a new Capital City Downtown Revitalization Zone fund, 12 new police officers, a University of Utah donation for a baseball stadium, and vehicle fleet funding, deferring final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Jordan River Fairpark District Zoning Map & Text Amendment and defer action to a future council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the second public hearing on the proposed Jordan River Fairpark (JRF) zoning district at approximately 1500 West North Temple and defers the Council's adoption vote to a future meeting, given the December 31, 2024 state law deadline for a development agreement.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 90 of 2024, temporarily closing a portion of 1000 West between South Temple and approximately 15 South.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and enacts an ordinance to temporarily close a segment of 1000 West to allow safety improvements to a railroad crossing so that the Woods Cross Quiet Zone can be restored after its suspension by the Federal Railroad Administration.
Approves all consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates for two zoning map amendments and reappointing Mary J. Woodhead as an Appeals Hearing Officer through December 3, 2029.
